name: The Sun and the Earth
summary: The simplest real gravitational system: one star, one planet, one nearly circular orbit of 365 days. A good place to watch energy and angular momentum stay constant.

source.provider: NASA NSSDCA Planetary Fact Sheet; NASA JPL Solar System Dynamics
source.reference: Planetary Fact Sheet (masses, radii); Approximate Positions of the Planets (a, e)
source.notes: Idealised coplanar model. Each body starts at its own perihelion. Semi-major axis, eccentricity, mass and radius are the true values from the cited sources; the orbital plane and each orbit's orientation angle are chosen for visual clarity. This is NOT an ephemeris and does not correspond to any real date. Radii are physical, not exaggerated: the renderer enforces a minimum on-screen size so small bodies remain visible without altering the simulation.
